name: Temporal Feedback Zoom Tracer
description: Reads the most recent history frame through a slight affine warp (zoom + rotation) then blends with the current frame. The compounding warp generates infinite self-generating psychedelic zoom tunnels from any video content. Nested monitor bezels stream out of the zoom focus, and each feedback pass drifts the hue so the tunnel walks through the spectrum. The camera is not square to its monitor, so the tunnel leans and spirals with a slow hand-held sway (and toward the pointer), and its auto-exposure keeps the loop lit.
